Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing rates for medically intensive home health care.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to medically intensive home health care rates; andadding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall by rule establish rates for medicallyintensive home health care that are equivalent to rates established forsimilar services by the department of labor and industries.
